description.fun: Tyrunt is a spoiled baby tyrannosaur from 100 million years ago, revived from a Jaw Fossil. When it doesn't get its way it throws a violent tantrum, and its jaws are strong enough to shred a car, so it hurts people without meaning to, even its own Trainer while playing. In its sleep it sometimes chomps at whatever's nearby, perhaps dreaming of a game.
description.guide: Tyrunt is a Rock- and Dragon-type Fossil Pokémon revived from the Jaw Fossil, based on a young Tyrannosaurus. It is selfish and throws violent tantrums, and its powerful jaws can cause injuries even in play. It evolves into Tyrantrum when levelled up during the day.
description.tagline: A toddler T. rex with a tantrum and a car-crushing bite

description.fun: Tyrantrum ruled 100 million years ago like a magnificent, vicious king, with jaws that shred thick metal plates like paper. Hitoshi Ariga gave it royal trappings: a crown of spikes, a feathery beard and a fur-lined cape, the feathers nodding to the idea that Tyrannosaurus had them. Nothing could stop it, so it slept out in the open without a care.
description.guide: Tyrantrum is a Rock- and Dragon-type Fossil Pokémon that evolves from Tyrunt, based on Tyrannosaurus rex. It is said to have been unstoppable in ancient times, with jaws strong enough to tear through metal. Its spiky crest, beard and cape-like ruff give it the look of a king.
description.tagline: The tyrant king of 100 million years ago
